accepted-source-defaults.effectiveDeploymentConfig: not-observed; source defaults only; P0.8/P7.5 required
accepted-source-defaults.runtimeOverrides: owner/runtime overrides and availability may further restrict; no active device state read

canonical-content.contract: Canonical pack/word revision and checksum; reviewed publication/provenance required. Starter inventory and editorial files do not certify every mode prompt. Pack detail gates definition/cloze/matching with pinned vocabulary; other registrations still require owner acceptance.

owner-derived-or-foundation.contract: No independent content pack. Consumes owner-scoped preferences, canonical evidence/time/progress or shared UI/activation policy; session/content identities are inherited where relevant.

ephemeral-unscored.contract: Local ephemeral scratchpad; no OCR, durable response or correctness/reward inference.

media-dependent.contract: Canonical prompt and provider/model/voice identity required at session time; availability, permission and device checks remain P6.4/P6.5.

journey-session-identity.contract: Adventure mixed review pins canonical session/prompt catalog; Ghost requires compatible recorded ghost identity/time. No fabricated live ghost/content revision.

assessment-question-set.readiness: needs-verification; research assessment hidden in field defaults
assessment-question-set.contract: Authored question/answer/explanation set revision required; exposure-only reading does not satisfy MG-10. No research activation or enrollment authorized.

inherit-related-records.contract: Resolve every related record; apply MG-specific acceptance in addition to shared mode/config/content. MG-03 selected and MG-04 typed remain distinct.
